(2) The camera cuts to close-ups of four distinct contestants: a woman in a white blouse with a hair bow, a man in a black blazer over a floral shirt, a man in a denim jacket with a microphone, and a woman with long dark hair. They appear focused and slightly tense. (3) On-screen graphics overlay the bottom and center, presenting a multiple-choice question. (11) [Slogan]: B 養來吃的鳥. [Logo]: 拜託ATM Battle ATM.
